columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Transaction identifier that is populated automatically for Oracle Cloud customers by the Load Interface File for Import program. Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number. Must be a unique, positive integer.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Recipient identifier. Use RECIPIENT_NAME instead.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_NAME
columns.description: Recipient name. Use the Manage Intercompany Organizations task to identify valid values.

columns.name: TO_LE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. To legal entity identifier. Populated by Import Intercompany Transactions process, based on the RECIPIENT_NAME.

columns.name: TO_LE_NAME
columns.description: To legal entity name. Use the Manage Intercompany Organizations task to identify valid values. Populated by the Import Intercompany Transactions process, based on the RECIPIENT_NAME.

columns.name: TO_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: To ledger identifier. Populated by the Import Intercompany Transactions process, based on the RECIPIENT_NAME.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier that is populated automatically for Oracle Cloud customers. Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: INIT_AMOUNT_CR
columns.description: Credit amount for the intercompany transaction.   You cannot populate both INIT_AMOUNT_DR and INIT_AMOUNT_CR.  They are mutually exclusive.

columns.name: INIT_AMOUNT_DR
columns.description: Debit amount for the intercompany transaction.  You cannot populate both INIT_AMOUNT_DR and INIT_AMOUNT_CR.  They are mutually exclusive.
